; REQ: LANG-2961 LANG-2962 LANG-2963 LANG-2964
Scriptname GreeterScript extends ObjectReference
{ Greets the player }
Int Property Count = 0 Auto
Event OnActivate(ObjectReference akActionRef)
    Count += 1
    If Count > 0 && True
        Debug.Notification("Hello, traveller! " + Count)
    EndIf
EndEvent
